title: 周一站会汇报进度并商量接手同事工作
titleEn: Giving your stand-up update and picking up a sick colleague's work
scene: 周一早上 9:15，你们组在 Teams 上开每天 15 分钟的站会（stand-up）。主持的是 Scrum Master Kirsty。轮到你时，你要说上周做了什么、今天做什么、有没有卡住的地方（blocker）。今天还有个意外：负责数据映射（data mapping）的同事 Priya 请了病假，可能要请好几天，Kirsty 会当场问你能不能先接她的活。大家说话快，还爱用缩写和澳洲口语，比如 “where are we at”、“across it”、“a fair bit on your plate”。
你的目标：① 用“上周—今天—blocker”三段清楚汇报 UAT 测试进度；② 听懂 Kirsty 的请求，不要一口答应，先说明自己手上的工作，问清优先级和截止时间；③ 约好会后具体交接（handover），并请她在 Teams 上把决定写下来。

facts.v: 周一 9:15，Teams 线上站会，限时 15 分钟
工资系统升级项目的 UAT 测试：40 个测试用例已完成 28 个
测试环境周五起一直很慢，等基础设施组修
Priya 病假，她的 data mapping 周四（26 日）要交初稿

vocab.zh: 站会（每天的简短进度会）
vocab.ex: Our stand-up is at quarter past nine every morning.
Where are we at with the UAT testing?
The only blocker is the test environment.
Are you across the data mapping at all?

vocab.en: have a lot on your plate
vocab.ex: I know you've got a fair bit on your plate this week.
Could you pick up Priya's tickets for a few days?
Can we do a quick handover after the stand-up?
Priya's crook, so she's off today.
Can we push the deadline back to Friday?
If I take this on, something else needs to be deprioritised.

vocab.en: a first cut / a first draft
vocab.ex: The first cut is due on Thursday.
Let's take that offline so we don't hold everyone up.

listening.en: Morning all, let's get cracking — we've got a fair bit to get through, so keep it snappy.
listening.sound: let's get cracking 连成 “lets-ged-crackin” = 开始吧；keep it snappy = 说简短点；a fair bit 读 “a fair-bi’” = 不少。
listening.zh: 大家早，开始吧——今天事儿挺多，大家说简短点。

listening.en: Righto, over to you — where're we at with UAT?
listening.sound: Righto 读 “rye-toe” = 好的；over to you = 轮到你了；where're we at 连成 “wair-wee-at” = 进展到哪了。
listening.zh: 好，轮到你了——UAT 测试进展到哪了？
listening.reply: Sure. Last week I finished twenty-eight of the forty test cases.

listening.en: Is that environment still playin' up? I thought infra were all over it.
listening.sound: playing up 吞掉 g = 出毛病；infra = infrastructure team 基础设施组；all over it = 正在全力处理。
listening.zh: 那个测试环境还在出问题吗？我以为基础设施组在全力搞呢。
listening.reply: It's still really slow. They said they'd have a look this morning.

listening.en: Heads-up, Priya's crook, so she'll be off for a few days by the sounds of it.
listening.sound: heads-up = 提前告诉一声；crook 读 “crook” = 生病（澳洲常用）；by the sounds of it = 听起来、看样子。
listening.zh: 提醒一下，Priya 病了，看样子要请几天假。
listening.reply: Oh no, I hope she feels better soon.

listening.en: Any chance you could pick up her data mapping? I know you've got a fair bit on your plate.
listening.sound: Any chance you could 连成 “enny-chance-ya-could” = 你能不能……（委婉请求）；on your plate = 手头的事。
listening.zh: 你有没有可能接一下她的数据映射？我知道你手上事也不少。
listening.reply: I can help, but I'd need to check the priorities first.

listening.en: Let's take that offline — can you and I jump on a call straight after this?
listening.sound: take that offline = 会后单独聊；jump on a call 连成 “jum-pon-a-call” = 打个电话/开个小会；straight after = 一结束就。
listening.zh: 这个会后再说吧——这个会一结束咱俩通个话行吗？
listening.reply: Sure, I'll stay on the call.

speech.topic: 我是怎么在站会上把进度说清楚的
paragraphs: When I first started working in an Australian office, I was really nervous about stand-up meetings. Everyone spoke so fast, and when it was my turn, I either talked for too long or forgot the most important part.

Now I use a simple pattern with three parts. First, I say what I finished yesterday or last week, with one clear number if I can. For example, "I finished twenty-eight of the forty test cases." Second, I say what I'm working on today. Third, I say if I have a blocker, and who I need help from. That's it. It usually takes less than a minute.

I also learnt that stand-up is not the place to solve big problems. If something needs a long discussion, I say, "Can we take that offline?" and we talk after the meeting. People really appreciate it, because nobody wants a fifteen-minute meeting to turn into forty minutes.

Another thing I've had to practise is saying no politely. When my manager asks me to take on extra work, I don't just say yes straight away. I explain what I'm already working on, and I ask which task is more important. Sometimes the deadline moves, and sometimes another task waits. Either way, it's much better than promising too much and then missing a deadline.
If I could give one tip to someone new, it would be this: write down your three points before the meeting starts. Even after a few years, I still do it every morning.
speech.zh: 刚在澳洲办公室上班时，我很怕站会：大家说话快，轮到我时不是说太长就是忘了重点。现在我用一个三段式：先说上周/昨天完成了什么，最好带一个具体数字；再说今天做什么；最后说有没有 blocker、需要谁帮忙。一般不到一分钟。我也学到站会不是解决大问题的地方，需要长时间讨论就说“会后再聊”，大家都很感激，因为没人想让 15 分钟的会拖到 40 分钟。另外我练习了礼貌地拒绝：经理让我多接工作时，我不会马上答应，而是先说明手上的工作，问哪个更重要。有时截止日期会推迟，有时别的任务先放一放，总比答应太多再误期好。给新人的建议：开会前先把三点写下来，我到现在每天早上都这么做。

patterns.en: Last week I finished ___. Today I'm working on ___. My only blocker is ___.
patterns.zh: 站会三段式：上周完成…今天做…卡在…

patterns.en: I'm happy to help with ___, but I'd need to ___ first.
patterns.zh: 我愿意帮忙……，但得先……（不直接拒绝）

patterns.en: If I take that on, ___ will have to wait. Which one is the priority?
patterns.zh: 如果我接了这个，……就得往后放。哪个优先？

patterns.en: Can we take ___ offline so we don't hold everyone up?
patterns.zh: ……能会后再聊吗？免得耽误大家。

lines.en: Morning all, let's get cracking — we've got a fair bit to get through today, so keep it snappy. Righto, over to you. Where're we at with UAT?
lines.zh: 大家早，开始吧——今天事挺多，大家说简短点。好，轮到你了。UAT 测试进展到哪了？

lines.en: Morning, Kirsty. So, last week I finished twenty-eight of the forty test cases for the payroll upgrade. Most of them passed, and I logged three defects in Jira.
lines.zh: 早，Kirsty。上周我完成了工资系统升级 40 个测试用例里的 28 个。大部分都通过了，我在 Jira 里记了三个缺陷。

lines.en: Nice one. Are any of those three showstoppers, or are we talkin' cosmetic stuff?
lines.zh: 不错。这三个里有致命的吗，还是只是界面小问题？

lines.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower? I didn't quite catch the last part.
lines.zh: 不好意思，能再说慢一点吗？后半句我没太听清。

lines.en: Yeah, sorry, I'm rabbiting on. I mean, are any of the defects serious enough to stop us going live? Or are they just small things, like spelling or layout?
lines.zh: 哦抱歉，我说太快了。我是说，这些缺陷里有没有严重到会阻止上线的？还是只是拼写、排版这种小问题？

lines.en: Two are just layout issues. But one is serious — the overtime rate isn't calculating correctly for part-time staff. I've marked it as high priority.
lines.zh: 两个只是排版问题。但有一个很严重——兼职员工的加班费算得不对。我已经标成高优先级了。

lines.en: Right, good catch. I'll make sure the devs are across that one today. And what's on for you this week?
lines.zh: 好，发现得好。我今天确保开发那边知道这个。你这周什么安排？

lines.en: Today I'm working on the leave and timesheet test cases. My only blocker is the test environment. It's been really slow since Friday, and some pages time out.
lines.zh: 今天我做请假和工时表的测试用例。唯一卡住的是测试环境，从周五起就特别慢，有些页面会超时。

lines.en: Is it still playin' up? I thought infra were all over it. I'll give Marcus a nudge after this and see if we can get an ETA.
lines.zh: 还在出问题？我以为基础设施组在全力处理呢。会后我催一下 Marcus，看能不能给个预计修好的时间。

lines.en: Thanks, that'd be great. If it's fixed by lunchtime, I should still finish UAT by Friday.
lines.zh: 谢谢，那太好了。如果中午前修好，我应该还能在周五前完成 UAT。

lines.en: Lovely. Oh, and heads-up, everyone — Priya's crook, so she'll be off for a few days by the sounds of it.
lines.zh: 好。哦，提醒大家一下——Priya 病了，看样子要请几天假。

lines.en: Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. I hope she's feeling better soon.
lines.zh: 哎呀，听到这个很遗憾。希望她快点好起来。

lines.en: Yeah, poor thing. Which leaves us a bit short. Any chance you could pick up her data mapping? The first cut's due Thursday, and the client's pretty keen to see it. I know you've got a fair bit on your plate, though.
lines.zh: 是啊，挺可怜的。这样我们就有点缺人了。你有没有可能接一下她的数据映射？初稿周四要交，客户挺急着想看。不过我知道你手上事也不少。

lines.en: Just to confirm, you mean the mapping from the old payroll system to the new one — the spreadsheet she's been working on?
lines.zh: 我确认一下，你是说从旧工资系统到新系统的数据映射——就是她一直在做的那个表格？

lines.en: Spot on, that's the one. She reckons it's about two-thirds done.
lines.zh: 对，就是那个。她说大概做了三分之二。

lines.en: I'm happy to help, but I'd need to check the priorities first. If I take that on, I probably can't finish UAT by Friday. Which one is more important?
lines.zh: 我愿意帮忙，但得先确认优先级。如果我接了这个，周五前可能完不成 UAT。哪个更重要？

lines.en: Hmm, fair point. Honestly, UAT's the bigger fish to fry. But the client's been chasing that mapping since last week.
lines.zh: 嗯，有道理。说实话，UAT 更重要。但客户从上周就一直在催那个映射。

lines.en: Maybe there's a middle option. Could we push the mapping back to Monday? Or I could do the most urgent tables first and send a partial draft on Thursday.
lines.zh: 也许可以折中一下。映射能不能推到下周一？或者我先做最急的几张表，周四先发一部分初稿。

lines.en: Ooh, I like that. A partial draft Thursday should keep them happy. Let's take that offline, though — we're holding everyone up. Can you and I jump on a call straight after this?
lines.zh: 哦，这个好。周四先给部分初稿应该能让他们满意。不过这个会后再聊吧——别耽误大家了。这个会一结束咱俩通个话行吗？

lines.en: Sure. Could you also check if Priya left any notes? A quick handover would really help me get up to speed.
lines.zh: 好的。你能不能也看看 Priya 有没有留下笔记？简单交接一下能帮我快点上手。

lines.en: Yep, she said it's all in the shared drive, in the folder called 'Mapping v3'. I'll flick you the link.
lines.zh: 有，她说都在共享盘里一个叫 'Mapping v3' 的文件夹。我把链接发你。

lines.en: Thanks. And after our call, could you put the new plan in the Teams channel, so everyone knows UAT might slip a day?
lines.zh: 谢谢。我们通完话后，你能把新安排发到 Teams 频道吗？这样大家都知道 UAT 可能会推迟一天。

lines.en: Too easy, I'll pop it in the channel. Cheers for being flexible — you're a legend. Okay, who's next? Dev team, over to you.
lines.zh: 没问题，我发到频道里。谢谢你这么灵活——你太给力了。好，下一个是谁？开发组，到你们了。

rescue.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，能再说慢一点吗？
不好意思，……是什么的缩写？

rescue.en: Can we take that offline? I'll follow up after the meeting.
rescue.zh: 这个能会后再聊吗？我会后跟进。

rescue.en: Could you put that in the Teams chat so I don't miss anything?
rescue.zh: 能把那个发到 Teams 聊天里吗？免得我漏掉。

checklist: 我能用“上周—今天—blocker”三段在一分钟内说完进度
我听懂了 where're we at、across it、playing up、crook、a fair bit on your plate
Kirsty 说太快时，我用了礼貌追问而不是假装听懂
被要求接手额外工作时，我没有马上答应，而是问清了优先级和截止时间
我提出了一个折中方案（推迟或先交部分初稿）
我请对方把新安排写在 Teams 里确认
